lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiFeO₂ (Li₂Fe₂O₄ per unit cell) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with eight atoms distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Fe centers with four O neighbors in a tetrahedral motif, while Li centers show eight geometric neighbors (four Fe and four O). The Fe tetrahedra share corners, and Fe–Li polyhedra share corners and edges, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
